edits.current: Must equal the number of UNIQUE contributors in the Record Tipo 2 detail, EXCLUDING those whose 'Tipo contributor' (T2R2-005) is 40 - Beneficiary UPC Adicional. That exclusion is easy to miss and produces a header-to-detail mismatch that the operador rejects. edits.proposed: Must equal the number of UNIQUE contributors in the Record Tipo 2 detail, EXCLUDING those whose 'Tipo contributor' (T2R2-005) is 40 - Beneficiary UPC Adicional. edits.current: Closed list CC, CE, TI, PA, CD, SC, RC, PE, PT (PT = Permiso por Protección Temporal). PE may not be used for health contribution periods from September 2023 onwards. An ALPHANUMERIC identification number is permitted only for PA and CD; for TI, CC, SC, RC, CE, PE and PT the number must be all digits. NOTE the divergence from the electronic payroll, which uses NUMERIC codes (13 = CC) rather than these two-letter codes - the engine must MAP, not copy. Bidirectional set with 'Foreign national not liable to contribute to pension' (T2R2-007), which where marked restricts this field to CE, PA, CD, SC, PE or PT, and with 'Colombian abroad' (T2R2-008), which is used only where this field is CC or TI. COMPOSITE KEY: together with T2R2-004 (Contributor identification number), this pair is the join key for the contributor across every Colombian artefact -- electronic payroll NIE044/NIE045, Form 220 casillas 24/25, Format 2276 numeral 2 -- matching the same pair convention documented on CO-SEVERANCE SAVINGS-006 T03/T04. Source: AT2 v30 (MinSalud, Res. 2388/2016 Anexo Técnico 2, version 30, 24-07-2026) §2.1.2.1 campos 3, 7 and 8. PMI source: Master Data has no document-type field. Derive the type from the populated document column: 'Citizenship Card ID' -> CC; 'Indentity Card for Foreigners' -> CE. Where more than one column is populated, a precedence rule is required, and the PILA code for the columns 'National ID' and 'Identity Card' must be confirmed by the client before mapping. An employee with no document column populated is a blocking data error. Sept-2026 evidence: of 261 employees, 234 have only 'Citizenship Card ID', 13 only 'Indentity Card for Foreigners', 14 have more than one document column populated and none has no document at all.

The trigger must be defined on payroll data: mark VST when the period's contribution base differs from the standing contractual salary because of salary-constituting variable payments (for PMI e.g. WT 62133 Variable, 62150 Vacation Bonus, 62207 Attendance Bonus; in Sept-2026, 46 of 241 employees had an IBC Total above their Salary Value). The exact list of wage types that trigger VST must be confirmed against the annex definition before configuration.

edits.current: A THREE-VALUE flag, not a simple X: X means vacation, L means remunerated leave. They map to two DIFFERENT electronic payroll blocks - VacacionesComunes (NIE109 to NIE112) and LicenciaR (NIE132 to NIE135) respectively - so the value carries real information and must not be normalised to X. PMI mapping: WT 79001 Annual leave -> X; WT 79018 Paid Leave -> L. Vacation compensated in cash (WT 79003) involves no rest period and has no reliable dates in the client data; whether it raises VAC-LR must be stated explicitly (to be confirmed against the annex definition of VAC-LR).

edits.current: SCOPE ROUTING (v1.1 alignment patch): the amount is owned by the Wage Type Catalogue, not the Data Dictionary - the pipeline scope rule routes 'Base Salary / Basic Salary amounts -> WTC, NOT DD'. The 'Payroll.' prefix marks it as outside DD master data; it is a standing contract attribute, not a per-run computation. Column E is therefore N and the Data Dictionary correctly holds no Contractual Salary field. The employee's basic salary. Distinct from the four IBC fields that follow: the IBC is the contribution base after non-salary payments, the 40% clamp and the ceiling and floor, whereas this is the contractual salary itself.
edits.proposed: The employee's basic salary - a standing contract attribute, not a per-run computation. The amount is owned by the Wage Type Catalogue (CO-SALARIO-BASICO), not by the Data Dictionary master data, which is why the system mapping carries the 'Payroll.' prefix and the Payroll Field column is N. Distinct from the four IBC fields that follow: the IBC is the contribution base after non-salary payments, the 40% clamp and the ceiling and floor, whereas this is the contractual salary itself.

edits.current: Tipo de salario. X = salario integral; F = salario fijo; V = salario variable. Where X, the contribution base is 70% of the integral salary, not 100%, because 30% is the statutory prestacional factor (CST art. 132 num. 2, minimum 13 SMMLV). Maps to electronic payroll SalarioIntegral (NIE056) for the X case. Source: AT2 v30 (MinSalud, Res. 2388/2016 Anexo Técnico 2, version 30, 24-07-2026) §2.1.2.1 campo 41 and §2.1.2.3.40. PMI source: no salary-type field in Master Data; X where the employee is paid WT 62140 Integral Salary in the period, F where paid WT 62100 Ordinary Salary; the rule for V must be confirmed. Where X, the 70% applies to the CCF base (T2R2-045) and to the parafiscal base (T2R2-095) as well as to the pension, health and occupational-risk IBC (CST art. 132; Ley 789 de 2002 art. 49; client WT 64991 = 70% of the integral salary).

edits.current: Contribution base for pension. FLOOR 1 SMMLV = COP 1,750,905; CEILING 25 SMMLV = COP 43,772,625 in 2026. Must reconcile to electronic payroll NIE166 divided by the rate in T2R2-046, allowing for the different rounding conventions. Bidirectional set with 'All-inclusive salary flag' (T2R2-041), which where marked sets this base to 70% of the all-inclusive salary, and with 'Solidarity pension fund - solidarity sub-account' (T2R2-051), which is payable only where this base reaches 4 SMMLV. Computation order: (a) salary-constituting pay of the period (70% of it for an integral salary); (b) plus the excess of non-salary payments over 40% of TOTAL remuneration (Ley 1393 de 2010 art. 30) - in the client's Sept-2026 data the 40% test is run on the full (100%) integral salary and the excess is added at 100% on top of the 70% base, an observed practice to be confirmed by RA, not a confirmed instruction; (c) floor 1 SMMLV, ceiling 25 SMMLV; (d) round UP to the whole peso (the payroll intermediate value may carry decimals, e.g. 17300699.5). PMI reference values: Detail IBC per Employees S.S. 'IBC Total' (the base on which WT 2556 = 4% is computed for 239 of 239 employees; 14 employees sit at the ceiling); G2N WT 64995 'Non-SSI excess' holds the Ley 1393 add-back.

Source: payroll field 'IBC Total' (the base on which WT 2556 Pension Plan Mandatory - AFP Employee, 4%, is computed); WT 64995 'Non-SSI excess' holds the Ley 1393 de 2010 add-back.

edits.current: Contribution base for health. Same floor and ceiling as pension. The four IBC values legitimately DIFFER from one another once a non-salary payment, a change event or a subsystem-specific rule enters - do not populate them from one variable. Bidirectional pair with 'Contributor exonerated from payment' (T2R2-076): where this base is at or above 10 SMMLV (COP 17,509,050 in 2026) T2R2-076 MUST be N (AT2 v30 campo 76); where it is below 10 SMMLV, T2R2-076 is S only if the total earnings of the month (total devengado) are also below 10 SMMLV (ET art. 114-1; Decreto 1828 de 2013 art. 7) - this base alone does not grant the exoneration. Same computation order as T2R2-042 (70% integral, Ley 1393 add-back, floor and ceiling, round UP to the peso). PMI reference (Sept-2026): Detail IBC per Employees S.S. 'IBC Total' is the base on which the client computes both the employee 4% (WT 2554) and the employer 8.5% (WT 2564) health contributions (4% of IBC Total for 239 of 239 employees).

edits.current: Contribution base for occupational risk. Same floor and ceiling. State explicitly how incapacity (IGE), maternity/paternity (LMA) and vacation/paid-leave (VAC-LR) days enter the ARL base and the ARL day count (T2R2-038). Client evidence: the ARL premium is computed on the same base as pension and health, including sick-leave and vacation days; this must be confirmed against the annex and Decreto 1072 de 2015 before configuration.

edits.current: 0.5% of the contribution base - 50% of the additional 1% (Ley 100 art. 27 num. 1 lit. a, as amended by Ley 797 de 2003 art. 8). Under AT2 v30 this value is LIQUIDATED BY THE INFORMATION OPERADOR according to the rules that apply to the contributor ('Lo liquida el Operador de Información'); the engine computes it for reconciliation and for the employee deduction, not as an input the operador accepts blindly. edits.current: THE PER-EMPLOYEE, PER-MONTH SIDE of the ET art. 114-1 exoneration (introduced by Ley 1607 de 2012 and confirmed by Ley 1819 de 2016 art. 65). Values are S and N, not X. The employer-level flag in A1-033 declares eligibility; THIS field applies it to a specific employee in a specific month. TWO RULES APPLY TOGETHER. (1) The exoneration test is on the TOTAL EARNINGS of the month (total devengado): the employee is exonerated where the total devengado of the month is below 10 SMMLV (COP 17,509,050 in 2026) - Decreto 1828 de 2013 art. 7. It is an earnings test, NOT a test on the health IBC. (2) In addition, AT2 v30 campo 76 requires N whenever the health contribution base in campo 43 (T2R2-043) is at or above 10 SMMLV. The field is therefore S only where BOTH the total devengado and the health IBC are below 10 SMMLV. The test is monthly, so an employee who crosses 10 SMMLV because of a bonus loses the exoneration for that month alone - the engine must evaluate it every period, never once a year. Where marked S, the employer's health 8.5%, SENA 2% and ICBF 3% fall away and the health rate in T2R2-054 becomes the EMPLOYEE rate alone (4%); pension, occupational risk and the CCF 4% remain payable in full. PMI evidence (Sept-2026): the client flags on an earnings figure, not on the IBC - all 88 integral-salary employees are non-exonerated, and a 'total monthly entitlements >= 10 SMMLV' test reproduces the client's flags in 233 of 241 cases, while the health-IBC test reproduces 222 of 241. No single test reproduces all 241 cases, and one employee with a health IBC above 10 SMMLV is exonerated in the client run, which rule (2) does not allow; the client's exact devengado definition is therefore to be confirmed (see Query to RA).
